Using the number tiles, Joan and Herbert played a new game.
They placed the numbers to make the largest answer.

B. Use the tiles [2], [3], and [7]. Write the numbers on the tiles in the boxes below to make the largest answer when you subtract.

[Image: Vertical subtraction layout with boxes]

descriptors: Any other arrangement of the digits 2, 3, and 7
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A vertical subtraction problem setup with two rows above a horizontal line. The top row has two square boxes side by side. The bottom row has a minus sign (−) on the left and a single square box aligned under the right box of the top row.
